title: Support batch ready-task intake for coordinators
description: Add a command path for retrieving multiple ready tasks, for example task ready --limit N, so a coordinator agent can inspect or distribute parallelizable work without racing claims. Reuse the same eligibility and assignee-safety rules as single-task inspection and document flat-file-only support.

comments.author: Jim
comments.message: Implementing task ready --limit N on top of the current readiness view, preserving single-task behavior at limit 1 and reusing the same eligibility and assignee-safety ordering for batch output.

comments.author: Jim
comments.message: Added task ready --limit N for batch inspection using the same eligibility and assignee-safety rules as single ready selection, and verified with ./scripts/check.sh.
